title: Emergency!

S1 E3 — Mascot
Gage promises to care for an injured woman's dog; the paramedics save five lives including a diabetic and a man trapped on a ledge.

An injured cameraman proves to have more than a broken leg, leading Brackett to search for a botulism source; guest Susan Seaforth.

DeSoto and Gage deliver a baby over the father's protests; DeSoto worries about a dinner he is planning for the station-house crew.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E12 — Uncle Buckle-Up
The mob forces a children's TV-show host (Arte Johnson) to endorse cheap, unsafe Uncle Buckle-Up dolls.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E13 — Wheel of Fortune
Agents detour Murdock to South America when he embarks on a Hawaiian trip he won on "Wheel of Fortune"; guests Pat Sajak, Vanna White.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E14 — The A-Team Is Coming, The A-Team Is Coming
The team works with the Soviets to prevent an insane Soviet general from triggering World War III; guest William Smith.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E15 — Members Only
Face pursues a lifelong dream and cons his way into a posh country club, only to discover counterfeiters working off the seventh green.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E16 — Cowboy George
A concert deal appears shaky when Face inadvertently books Boy George & Culture Club into a rowdy cowboy nightclub.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E17 — Waiting for Insane Wayne
The team pretends to be mercenaries to protect a teenage squatter (Moosie Drier) from an unscrupulous landowner.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E18 — The Duke of Whispering Pines
B.A.'s old girlfriend (Sheila DeWindt) calls on him to find her investor husband, B.A.'s former school rival.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E19 — Beneath the Surface
The team helps Face's old high-school buddy (Tom Villard) locate a sunken Spanish galleon filled with treasure.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E20 — Mission of Peace
The team outmaneuvers swindlers plotting to evict a group of enterprising senior citizens; guest Jason Evers.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S3 E1 — Metamorphosis
Banner reverts to the Hulk to save a rock singer (Mackenzie Phillips) from an onstage suicide.
